parameters.content:
## TikTok Verified Mention Tracker

**Actor:** [TikTok Verified Mention Tracker](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/tiktok-profile-mention-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/tiktok-verified-mention-tracker.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `usernames` (array, required)
- `mentionFilter` (string)
- `excludeOwnPosts` (boolean)
- `datePosted` (string)
- `postedAfter` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `minPlayCount` (integer)
- `searchDepth` (string)
- `searchCountry` (string)
- `followRelatedVideos` (boolean)
- `maxResultsPerProfile` (integer)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `targetUsername` (Tracked account)
- `mentionType` (Mention type)
- `postUrl` (Post)
- `caption` (Caption)
- `createdAt` (Posted)
- `author.username` (Posted by)
- `author.followerCount` (Author followers)
- `playCount` (Views)
- `likeCount` (Likes)
- `commentCount` (Comments)
- `shareCount` (Shares)
- `postType` (Type)

description: TikTok verified mention: runs the TikTok Verified Mention Tracker Apify Actor, returns targetUsername, postUrl, author.followerCount, playCount, likeCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
